[api] …and the metadata is right (adminA: its username and display name)
[api] candidates: 200, a list of {userId, username, displayName, email}

[api] current members are not candidates (adminA)
[api] a SYSTEM_ADMIN account (activated, enabled, a workspace member, former tenant member) is never a candidate
[api] a non-activated account and a disabled account are not candidates

typing the search shows adminB (name · email) in the candidate list, and not the SYSTEM_ADMIN / disabled / non-activated accounts
add candidate: the server lists adminB as an active MEMBER, with metadata
the member appears in the table with his name
the candidate disappears after the add (API and picker)

[api] adding that SYSTEM_ADMIN account by id → 404 (not eligible, no oracle)
